name: Indian Scout (1920-1931, 101)
engine: 37 or 45 cubic inch air-cooled side-valve V-twin, gear primary, total-loss oiling
intro: Indian's early Scouts, including the famous 101. A geared primary drive, a flathead V-twin and total-loss oiling.

E: It is a flathead. The valves sit beside the cylinder, so set the tappets with the engine cold and check the valve guides for wear.
H: Check whether yours has a total-loss or a recirculating oil system before you fill it, and know which one you are running.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
